name: web_search
description: Search the public web when the user asks about something that requires up to date information from the internet — current events, library docs, third-party services, news, etc. Returns up to 20 results: each is `{title, link, snippet, published_date?}`. Snippets are short — call `open_urls([link, ...])` on the most promising result(s) to read the full page(s) in a single call.

query.description: Search query. Be specific — e.g. "flask 3.0 streaming response keep-alive" is preferable to "flask streaming".
